name: Kaggle-Survey-2017-2020-Merged-Data
description:
Context
Every year Kaggle conducts an industry-wide survey that presents a truly comprehensive view of the state of data science and machine learning. This dataset combines the data from the past 4 years (2017-2020).
Content
Data was acquired and cleaned by Kaggle Team. I merged the dataset over the years using the notebook. https://www.kaggle.com/harveenchadha/merging-all-historical-survey-data-2017-2020
